global_style.art_style: Minimalist hand-drawn stickman illustration style for an engaging YouTube finance short. Warm off-white paper background, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, simple expressive round white faces, thin black stick limbs, and a small red bow tie on the recurring presenter. Limited accent colors: green for money, yellow for ideas, and blue for technology. Friendly, humorous, conversational visual storytelling. Every image should feel like a frame from the same illustrated explainer. Clear silhouettes, uncluttered compositions, strong visual hierarchy, vertical 9:16 framing.
global_style.negative_prompt: Photorealism, 3D rendering, realistic human anatomy, detailed skin, complex backgrounds, excessive colors, gradients, clutter, tiny unreadable text, watermarks, logos, inconsistent stickman designs, extra limbs, distorted faces, illegible lettering.

main_presenter.label: Finance Stickman Presenter
main_presenter.visual_dna: A simple hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, two expressive black eyes, a curved expressive mouth, thin black arms and legs, and a small red bow tie. Consistent proportions and recognizable appearance in every frame.

money_symbol.label: Money Illustration
money_symbol.visual_dna: Simple hand-drawn green currency notes, coins, and a small money bag, outlined in black, without real currency-specific designs.

beats.narration_text: पैसे कमाने हैं, लेकिन समझ नहीं आ रहा कि शुरुआत कहाँ से करें?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie stands in the center, looking confused while holding an empty wallet upside down. A few tiny coins fall out. Minimal off-white paper background, bold imperfect black ink outlines, green coin accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the presenter looking directly at the viewer with a puzzled expression.

beats.narration_text: तो चलो, जानते हैं पैसे कमाने के पाँच ऐसे तरीके, जिनसे तुम शुरुआत कर सकते हो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie suddenly gets an idea. A large yellow light bulb appears above the head, surrounded by five small green money symbols. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black hand-drawn outlines, vertical 9:16 framing.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the presenter look excited and point upward toward the five symbols.

beats.narration_text: पहला तरीका है अपनी स्किल बेचकर पैसे कमाना।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie stands confidently beside a laptop displaying creative work. Several green coins float nearby. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, small blue and green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter gestures confidently toward the laptop.

beats.narration_text: जैसे वीडियो एडिटिंग, ग्राफिक डिजाइनिंग या वेबसाइट बनाना।
beats.prompt_action: Three hand-drawn mini scenes arranged vertically: a stickman editing a video timeline on a laptop, another designing a colorful poster on a computer, and another building a website with simple blocks and code. All characters have round white faces, thin black limbs, and simple black outlines. Off-white paper background with restrained blue and yellow accents, vertical 9:16 layout.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make each skill visually distinct and easy to recognize.

beats.narration_text: इन सेवाओं को छोटे बिजनेस या ऑनलाइन क्लाइंट्स को ऑफर करो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie sits at a laptop sending a service proposal. On the other side, a small business owner stickman happily receives the proposal. A green payment symbol appears between them. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a clear client-to-freelancer interaction.

beats.narration_text: शुरुआत में एक छोटी स्किल सीखो, काम के नमूने बनाओ और क्लाइंट ढूँढो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie proudly displays a small portfolio folder containing three sample designs on a laptop screen. A checklist and a green coin sit beside the folder. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, simple yellow and green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter proudly points at the completed portfolio.

beats.narration_text: दूसरा तरीका है ऑनलाइन ट्यूशन देना।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie stands beside a large whiteboard holding a marker. A small laptop is open nearby. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter looks like a friendly teacher ready to explain something.

beats.narration_text: अगर तुम्हें मैथ्स, इंग्लिश, कोडिंग या कोई सब्जेक्ट अच्छे से आता है,
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman teacher with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie stands in front of a whiteboard showing simple math symbols, English letters, and a tiny programming code window. Three student stickmen sit attentively with notebooks. Bold black outlines, off-white paper background, restrained blue and yellow accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the teacher pointing toward the different subjects while students listen.

beats.narration_text: तो बच्चों या दूसरे स्टूडेंट्स को ऑनलाइन पढ़ा सकते हो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman teacher with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie teaches through a laptop video call. Three small student faces appear in separate video-call panels on the screen. The teacher points at a simple digital whiteboard. Minimal off-white background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the laptop screen and teaching interaction the main focus.

beats.narration_text: एक विषय चुनो, अपनी टाइमिंग तय करो और पहले कुछ स्टूडेंट्स से शुरुआत करो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman teacher with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie writes a simple weekly timetable on a board. Two student stickmen sit at a desk with open books. A small green payment icon appears near the timetable. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a practical, organized tutoring setup.

beats.narration_text: तीसरा तरीका है कंटेंट बनाना।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie stands in front of a smartphone mounted on a small tripod, ready to record a video. A tiny yellow idea bulb floats above the phone. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter looks enthusiastic and ready to record.

beats.narration_text: यूट्यूब, इंस्टाग्राम या किसी प्लेटफॉर्म पर ऐसी चीजें शेयर करो, जो लोगों के काम आएँ।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman creator with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie records a short educational video using a smartphone and tripod. Around the creator are simple illustrated icons of a camera, a helpful tutorial, a recipe card, and a learning notebook. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, small blue and yellow accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the creator actively recording useful content.

beats.narration_text: शुरुआत में व्यूज़ के पीछे मत भागो, लगातार अच्छी वीडियो बनाओ।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman creator with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie looks determined while editing a video on a laptop. A calendar with several marked days and a row of completed video thumbnails are visible. A large distracting view counter is crossed out. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Emphasize consistency and quality rather than chasing numbers.

beats.narration_text: आगे चलकर कमाई विज्ञापनों, ब्रांड डील्स और अपने प्रोडक्ट्स से हो सकती है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman creator with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie stands beside three clear income illustrations: a video screen with a small advertisement symbol, a handshake between two stickmen representing a brand partnership, and a digital product displayed on a laptop. Green coins appear near each illustration. Off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show three separate possible income sources, not instant guaranteed money.

beats.narration_text: चौथा तरीका है डिजिटल प्रोडक्ट्स बेचना।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie stands beside a laptop displaying a digital shop with simple downloadable products. The presenter points toward the screen. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, small green and blue accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the digital shop look simple and approachable.

beats.narration_text: जैसे ई-बुक, नोट्स, टेम्पलेट्स या डिजाइन फाइल्स।
beats.prompt_action: Four hand-drawn digital products arranged clearly: an e-book cover, a collection of study notes, a planner template, and a graphic design file shown on a laptop screen. A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie points toward them. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, restrained green and yellow accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep each digital product visually distinct.

beats.narration_text: एक बार अच्छा प्रोडक्ट बनाओ, फिर उसे ऑनलाइन कई लोगों को बेच सकते हो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman creator with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie uploads one digital planner from a laptop. Several separate customer stickmen receive their own copies on small screens, with green payment symbols appearing beside the transactions. Off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Illustrate one product reaching multiple customers, without implying guaranteed sales.

beats.narration_text: पाँचवाँ तरीका है रीसेलिंग या छोटा ऑनलाइन बिजनेस।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie stands beside a small table displaying neatly packed products and cardboard parcels. A simple smartphone shows an online store. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, green and blue accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter introduces the small business idea with an inviting gesture.

beats.narration_text: ऐसे प्रोडक्ट चुनो जिनकी लोगों को सच में जरूरत हो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman entrepreneur with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie studies three everyday products on a table: a water bottle, a notebook, and a small desk lamp. A magnifying glass highlights product quality while a customer stickman examines one item. Off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Focus on choosing useful products and understanding customers.

beats.narration_text: फिर उनकी कीमत, डिलीवरी और अपना मुनाफा सही से समझकर बेचो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman entrepreneur with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie calculates a simple product budget on a notebook. Three clearly drawn symbols represent purchase cost, delivery cost, and remaining profit. A small parcel sits beside the notebook. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the presenter carefully calculating costs before selling.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन एक बात याद रखना, जल्दी अमीर बनाने वाले वादों से बचना।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie steps away from a suspicious sign showing a flashy money bag and a large exaggerated promise symbol. The presenter raises one hand in a warning gesture. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, red warning accent, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Give the presenter a serious but friendly warning expression.

beats.narration_text: किसी भी काम में समय, मेहनत और सीखने की जरूरत होती है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie climbs a staircase made of three large steps labeled visually with a book, a clock, and a small completed project. A few green coins wait at the top. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show progress as gradual effort rather than instant success.

beats.narration_text: तो इनमें से एक तरीका चुनो और आज ही पहला कदम उठाओ।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie confidently takes the first step forward. Behind the presenter are five small icons representing freelancing, tutoring, content creation, digital products, and reselling. A large yellow light bulb shines above. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End with an energetic, encouraging pose.

beats.narration_text: और कमेंट में बताओ, तुम कौन सा तरीका आज़माने वाले हो?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive friendly eyes, thin black limbs, and a red bow tie points toward a large empty speech bubble and a simple comment icon. The presenter smiles directly at the viewer. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black outlines, small green accent, clean vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Finish with a friendly inviting expression and a clear comment gesture.
